item.tib: mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol las gang zag dbang po 'bring dang tha ma'i don bar do'i gdams pa gsal ba'i sgron me
item.coloph: ces rdzogs pa chen po'i mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang gros gyi rgyud las/ rab do gsal ba'i sgron me 'di yang / snyigs ma'i kho bo 'ja' tshon snying pos gang shar rang grol gyi/ rgyal rong chu chen rgyal po'i mnga' ris dang / bon gyi mdun ('dus) sa chen po/ dga' ldan g.yung drung gling gi gzim chung du bgyis pa/ sa rta zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes la dge'o//
